answer: Audits are written down in falcon, queued in orchard, and anchor publishes the wait time. A farm of 110 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 24 identities per epoch. A farm of 763 identities would post 3803 proofs and burn roughly 75 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
